title: Fredrikstad Norway, Moored Boat Harbor Pier - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Her ligger den i båt-
havnen i Fredrikstad
description: A tranquil maritime view captured in Fredrikstad, Norway, featuring a white wooden launch or motorboat resting quietly in the calm waters of the harbor next to a long wooden pier. Reflections shimmer across the water's surface beneath an overcast sky, with silhouettes of other boats and shoreline structures visible in the distance. The Norwegian inscription on the reverse notes the vessel's mooring location.
